Beyond the Knicks and Celtics, the Spurs vs. Rockets clash later tonight is also a prominent option at Polymarket. 
 How Does Polymarket Work?
 Polymarket is a CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange, not a sportsbook. On this platform, users buy and sell Yes or No contracts on specific event outcomes. These contracts are priced between 1 and 99 cents, where the current price directly reflects the broader market’s implied probability of that outcome occurring. When the event concludes, these contracts settle at $1 if the prediction is correct and $0 if it is incorrect. This implied probability impacts the potential payout you can get, so take that into account when making your predictions.
 Because it operates as an exchange, there is no house or bookmaker setting a line and taking the other side of your trade. This eliminates the vig, creating higher potential payouts. As a result of this structure, users are not locked in until the final buzzer, as positions can usually be sold on the open market before an event resolves.
 Where Can You Trade With Polymarket?
 To trade on the platform, users must be 18 years of age or older and physically located in an eligible US state. The platform is legally accessible to users in every US state except Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Montana, Nevada, Ohio, and Washington. It is important to note that prediction markets remain the subject of ongoing legal and regulatory challenges at the state level, meaning the list of available states can occasionally change. Readers should always confirm their specific eligibility and review local regulations during sign-up.
 Why Polymarket Promo Code AMNY Is The Best Choice for Knicks vs. Celtics Tonight
 This welcome offer stands out for new Polymarket customers because it delivers high value with exceptionally low entry requirements ahead of the Friday, October 23 matchup between the Knicks and Celtics. Our team directly tested the sign-up and qualification process, confirming the $25 in bonuses are credited after executing a $10 deposit.
 The offer is especially great for those looking to secure a bonus before placing their initial trade on the platform. Punch in the code AMNY to secure this reward. 
 Polymarket Promo Code AMNY: FAQ
 What’s the Polymarket promo code?
 Use AMNY when you sign up to get the new-customer offer: deposit $10 and receive $25 in bonuses.
 How do I get the bonus?
 Make a first deposit of at least $10. The bonus is usually credited within 12–24 hours. 
 Can I use Polymarket in my state?
 You must be 18 or older and in an eligible state. Polymarket is unavailable in Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Montana, Nevada, Ohio, and Washington. Check eligibility when you sign up, as rules can change.
 Is Polymarket a sportsbook?
 No. It’s a CFTC-regulated prediction market exchange where users trade event contracts with each other.
 Can I use the bonus on Knicks vs. Celtics?
 Yes. You can use the bonus on this game or other available NBA markets.
